rules.reason: read-only work with a checkable answer: start cheap, raise effort only for the runs that fail
large read-only input: more effort before a bigger model
the tests or a diff check verify it: run low, re-run only the failures higher
the change touches a risk path: a wrong edit costs more than the model
small low-risk change: a routine review is enough
review judges other work: keep it at the deep tier
design choices are hard to verify mechanically
a wide failure surface needs the deeper tier before more effort
medium implementation: raise effort before the tier
no rule matched (for example a large mechanical edit): routine tier at medium effort
